pages.name: Scandinavian: 2...Qxd5 3.Nc3 Qa5 4.Nf3 Nf6 5.Be2

pages.name: Scandinavian: 2...Qxd5, Main Line, 6.Bc4 Bf5
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote an ambiguous ...Nd7-b6; plans 1 and 2 wrote castling as 0-0. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 (reviewer: plan 1 rejected once for unpinning after castling, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.notes: Plan 3 pushed an e4-pawn that isn't there and said Qe2 unpins the knight; plan 1 pushed g4 into the bishop; plan 2 pushed ...b5-b4 against the c4-bishop. Rewrote all four plans (reviewer: plan 3 rejected once, revised, re-accepted); British spelling.

pages.name: Scandinavian: 2...Qxd5, Main Line, 8.Qe2 Bb4 9.a3
